'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Mike Richards DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-30-Combat_Readiness-remaster.webp|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Deck name:''' Kyle Krueger drinks his own pee.
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
